description: Leuk Castle, the bishop’s castle, stands above the town of Leuk. A square tower of about nine metres on a side sits inside an irregular ring wall, with two rectangular residential buildings beside it. Leukerbad and the Gemmi cliff are a different municipality and are not in this frame. The exterior carries no banner. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 17°C, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
